meta.name: help
meta.description: Show documentation for pk and its commands

inlines.text: Renders plankit's documentation in a terminal. The same pages ship as skills in the plugin, compiled from one source.

blocks.text:
pk help
pk help <topic>
pk help document
pk help document > plankit.md
pk help document --format man > pk.1

inlines.text: Without a topic, prints the index. A terminal gets styled, wrapped text; a pipe gets the raw authored bytes, so what Claude reads is the skill file.

is every page in index order, read as one document. It takes the same fork: rendered at a terminal, and through a pipe the pages as markdown with their frontmatter removed. That makes it a reader's document; a single topic is still the authored bytes.
, a page for a topic or one for the whole document, and a flag outranks the terminal probe. Nothing is installed: redirect it where you want it.

blocks.text:
--project-dir <value>
        Project directory (default: PK_PROJECT_DIR, else the current directory)
  --plain
        Undecorated output: no color, no wrapping
  --quiet
        Suppress notes and hints (errors still print)

--format <value>
        Output format: text or man (default text)
